column1: By the year 2050, nearly 80% of the Earth’s population will live in urban centres.
column2: 到2050年，全球将有接近80%的人口居住在城市地区。

column1: Applying the most conservative estimates to current demographic trends, the human population will increase by about three billion people by then.
column2: 即使按最保守的估算，根据当前的人口变化趋势，到那时世界人口也将增加约30亿。
column3: most conservative estimates|最保守的估算
column4: current demographic trends|当前的人口变化趋势

column1: An estimated 10⁹ hectares of new land (about 20% larger than Brazil) will be needed to grow enough food to feed them, if traditional farming methods continue as they are practised today.
column2: 如果继续沿用今天的传统耕作方式，为种出足够的食物养活这些人，预计还需要十亿公顷的新耕地，面积比巴西约大20%。
column5: larger than Brazil|比巴西的国土面积大
column7: traditional farming methods|传统耕作方式

column1: At present, throughout the world, over 80% of the land that is suitable for raising crops is in use.
column2: 目前，全球适宜种植作物的土地已有80%以上在使用中。

column1: Historically, some 15% of that has been laid waste by poor management practices.
column2: 从以往的情况看，其中约有15%已经因管理不善而荒废。
column6: poor management practices|不善的管理方式

column1: What can be done to ensure enough food for the world’s population to live on?
column2: 怎样做才能确保世界人口有足够的食物维生？

column1: The concept of indoor farming is not new, since hothouse production of tomatoes and other produce has been in vogue for some time.
column2: 室内农业并非新概念：在温室里生产番茄和其他农产品，早已流行了一段时间。

column1: What is new is the urgent need to scale up this technology to accommodate another three billion people.
column2: 不同以往的是，如今迫切需要扩大这项技术的应用规模，以满足新增30亿人口的需求。
column6: another three billion people|另外三十亿人

column1: Many believe an entirely new approach to indoor farming is required, employing cutting-edge technologies.
column2: 许多人认为，室内农业需要采用全新的方式，运用最前沿的技术。

column1: One such proposal is for the ‘Vertical Farm’.
column2: 有人就提出了建设“垂直农场”的方案。

column1: The concept is of multi-storey buildings in which food crops are grown in environmentally controlled conditions.
column2: 这个构想是在多层建筑中种植粮食作物，并对生长环境加以控制。
column6: environmentally controlled conditions|环境受到控制的条件

column1: Situated in the heart of urban centres, they would drastically reduce the amount of transportation required to bring food to consumers.
column2: 这样的农场位于城市中心，可以大幅减少把食物送到消费者手中所需的运输量。
column4: in the heart of|在……的中心

column1: Vertical farms would need to be efficient, cheap to construct and safe to operate.
column2: 垂直农场需要效率高、建造成本低，还要能安全运行。
column6: safe to operate|可安全运行的

column1: If successfully implemented, proponents claim, vertical farms offer the promise of urban renewal, sustainable production of a safe and varied food supply (through year-round production of all crops), and the eventual repair of ecosystems that have been sacrificed for horizontal farming.
column2: 倡议者称，如果顺利实施，垂直农场有望促进城市更新，还可通过全年种植各类作物，持续供应安全、多样的食物，最终也有望修复那些曾为传统平面耕作而牺牲的生态系统。

column1: It took humans 10,000 years to learn how to grow most of the crops we now take for granted.
column2: 人类用了一万年才学会种植如今大多已被我们视为理所当然的作物。
column6: take for granted|视为理所当然

column1: Along the way, we despoiled most of the land we worked, often turning verdant, natural ecozones into semi-arid deserts.
column2: 在这一过程中，我们毁坏了大部分自己耕作的土地，常常把草木葱茏的天然生态区变成半干旱沙漠。
column3: Along the way|在这一路演变中
column5: land we worked|我们耕作的土地

column1: Within that same time frame, we evolved into an urban species, in which 60% of the human population now lives vertically in cities.
column2: 同一时期，人类也渐渐成为一个聚居城市的物种；如今60%的人口已在城市中住进楼房，向上发展居住空间。
column3: Within that same time frame|在同一时期
column6: vertically|adv. 在向上发展的空间里

column1: This means that, for the majority, we humans have shelter from the elements, yet we subject our food-bearing plants to the rigours of the great outdoors and can do no more than hope for a good weather year.
column2: 这意味着，大多数人都有居所遮风避雨，我们却让赖以为食的作物经受室外严酷条件的考验，除此之外只能祈求有个好年景。
column4: shelter from the elements|遮风避雨的居所
column8: the great outdoors|户外自然环境

column1: However, more often than not now, due to a rapidly changing climate, that is not what happens.
column2: 然而，由于气候正迅速变化，如今的年景多数时候并不如人所愿。
column3: more often than not|多半、往往
column5: rapidly changing climate|迅速变化的气候

column1: Massive floods, long droughts, hurricanes and severe monsoons take their toll each year, destroying millions of tons of valuable crops.
column2: 每年，特大洪水、长期干旱、飓风和猛烈的季风都会造成损失，毁掉数百万吨珍贵作物。

column1: The supporters of vertical farming claim many potential advantages for the system.
column2: 垂直农业的支持者认为，这一系统可能有许多好处。

column1: For instance, crops would be produced all year round, as they would be kept in artificially controlled, optimum growing conditions.
column2: 例如，作物始终处在人工控制的最佳生长条件下，因此可以全年生产。

column1: There would be no weather-related crop failures due to droughts, floods or pests.
column2: 不会再有因干旱、洪水或虫害造成的这类与天气有关的作物歉收。

column1: All the food could be grown organically, eliminating the need for herbicides, pesticides and fertilisers.
column2: 所有食物都可以用有机方式生产，无须使用除草剂、杀虫剂或肥料。
column4: eliminating the need for|免去对……的需要

column1: The system would greatly reduce the incidence of many infectious diseases that are acquired at the agricultural interface.
column2: 这种系统还能大幅降低许多传染病的发病率，这些疾病是人们在与农业生产接触的过程中感染的。
column6: agricultural interface|与农业生产接触的环节

column1: Although the system would consume energy, it would return energy to the grid via methane generation from composting non-edible parts of plants.
column2: 虽然系统会消耗能源，但也能把植物不可食用的部分做成堆肥，利用由此产生的甲烷发电并向电网回馈能源。

column1: It would also dramatically reduce fossil fuel use, by cutting out the need for tractors, ploughs and shipping.
column2: 它还能省去使用拖拉机和犁以及运输作物的需要，从而大幅减少化石燃料的用量。
column5: cutting out the need for|免去对……的需要

column1: A major drawback of vertical farming, however, is that the plants would require artificial light.
column2: 不过，垂直农业有一项主要缺点：作物需要人工照明。

column1: Without it, those plants nearest the windows would be exposed to more sunlight and grow more quickly, reducing the efficiency of the system.
column2: 没有人工照明，靠窗最近的作物就会比其他作物照到更多阳光，长得更快，从而降低整个系统的效率。
column3: nearest the windows|离窗户最近的

column1: Single-storey greenhouses have the benefit of natural overhead light: even so, many still need artificial lighting.
column2: 单层温室有从上方照入的自然光，即使这样，仍有不少单层温室需要人工照明。

column1: A multi-storey facility with no natural overhead light would require far more.
column2: 顶部没有自然光照入的多层设施，对人工照明的需求会大得多。
column4: natural overhead light|从上方照入的自然光

column1: Generating enough light could be prohibitively expensive, unless cheap, renewable energy is available, and this appears to be rather a future aspiration than a likelihood for the near future.
column2: 除非有廉价的可再生能源可用，否则提供充足照明的成本可能高到令人望而却步；而获得这样的能源似乎更像是未来的愿望，在近期实现的可能性不大。
column3: Generating enough light|提供足够的照明

column1: One variation on vertical farming that has been developed is to grow plants in stacked trays that move on rails.
column2: 一种已经开发出来的垂直农业变体，是把作物种在层层叠放、可沿轨道移动的托盘上。

column1: Moving the trays allows the plants to get enough sunlight.
column2: 移动托盘，作物就能得到充足的阳光。

column1: This system is already in operation, and works well within a single-storey greenhouse with light reaching it from above: it is not certain, however, that it can be made to work without that overhead natural light.
column2: 这种系统已投入实际运行，在顶部能透进阳光的单层温室中效果良好。然而，没有来自上方的自然光，它是否还能发挥作用，目前尚不确定。
column8: overhead natural light|由上方照入的自然光

column1: Vertical farming is an attempt to address the undoubted problems that we face in producing enough food for a growing population.
column2: 人口不断增长，为此生产足够食物确实面临种种问题；垂直农业正是应对这些问题的一种尝试。

column1: At the moment, though, more needs to be done to reduce the detrimental impact it would have on the environment, particularly as regards the use of energy.
column2: 不过，就目前而言，要减轻垂直农业可能给环境带来的不利影响，还有更多工作要做，尤其是在能源使用方面。

column1: While it is possible that much of our food will be grown in skyscrapers in future, most experts currently believe it is far more likely that we will simply use the space available on urban rooftops.
column2: 将来，我们的许多食物有可能在摩天大楼里种出来。不过，目前多数专家认为，我们更有可能只利用城市屋顶的现成空间来种植。
column6: far more likely|可能性大得多
